description: Crawl a website from a start URL and return up to 20 same-site HTML pages as clean Markdown with title and description (breadth-first, 3 in parallel, skips files and non-HTML). Optional path_prefix keeps the crawl inside a section such as /docs. Charged only if at least one page was read. Params: url (required), max_pages (1 to 20, default 5), max_chars per page (500 to 20000, default 4000), path_prefix. Price: $0.015 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"url":"https://agentsvc.io/docs","max_pages":3,"max_chars":2000}.

path_prefix.description: Only follow links whose path starts with this, e.g. /docs

name: site_crawl
title: Site Crawl to Markdown
